description: Election Commission - B. M. Nirantha Dulwan Harsha was Selected as the member of the Welivitiya Division Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government bodies.
